title: Record the source value of the second half
body:
## Summary
- Immediately before event 24280, register 354 holds `-1` when register 359 starts at `1`. The data register contributes `0`.
- The addition multiplies that value by `64` and contributes `-64` to register 103, which already holds `-64`.
- Register 354 passes through `-1/4` at event 18932 and `-1/2` at event 19679 before event 20745 leaves `-1`. No selected frontier change and no new exponent.
